name: Pyre caller
description: an old hunched hell imp elder of the Ember Wastes: wrinkled dark crimson skin, long drooping horns, ragged bat wings, a heavy hooded cloak of black soot and ash trailing smoke, a long white beard of smoke, one bony fist held up wreathed in a crackling flame, a string of smouldering incense beads

poses.stand: hovering hunched on ragged wings, the flaming fist held up high, cloak of soot trailing smoke
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers hunched, muttering, smoke curling from its cloak, the flame in its fist flickering

attack.action: raises the flaming fist and chants, the flame swelling, and a little living flame spark crawls out of its fist and drops forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
